description: List recent delivery attempts across your workspace's webhook endpoints, newest first: the event, the status your endpoint answered with and when. Use it to find an endpoint that is failing. Needs a key with no scope limits or a person's sign-in. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

limit.description: Most deliveries to return. Defaults to 50.

name: list_webhook_deliveries
